_Requested by **Sujendra** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01RZMF1AyitESwqRzgJaJ7qE?thread=cmsg_01RZMF1AyitESwqRzgJaJ7qE8k2f1r5Tb3fiL9XokQrjWV)_

## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). (External contributor; labels to be added by a maintainer.)

## Affected area

Python API or bindings (`tools/cudnn_repro` dev tool; also touches its packaging metadata in `pyproject.toml`)

## Summary

- `tools/cudnn_repro/cudnn_repro/log_parser.py`: import `Optional` and change `-> Tuple[str, dict] | None` (`_parse_context_entry`) and `-> Tuple[int, List[int]] | None` (`_parse_tensor_dump`) to `Optional[...]` forms.
- `tools/cudnn_repro/pyproject.toml`: `requires-python` `>=3.8` -> `>=3.9`.

## Why

`Tuple[...] | None` is evaluated at definition time and raises `TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |: '_GenericAlias' and 'NoneType'` on Python before 3.10. As a result `import cudnn_repro.log_parser` and the `cudnn-repro` CLI crash on 3.9, even though CONTRIBUTING.md says Python >= 3.9 and the package declared >=3.8. Python 3.8 cannot work either, because other modules use builtin generics such as `list[...]` at definition time, so the declared minimum is raised to match reality.

## Related issues

None

## API and compatibility impact

Raises the declared minimum Python of the `cudnn-repro` dev tool from 3.8 to 3.9 (3.8 never worked). No behavior change on 3.10+.

## Testing

Before the change, on Python 3.9.25, from `tools/cudnn_repro`:

```
$ python -c "import cudnn_repro.log_parser"
TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |: '_GenericAlias' and 'NoneType'
```

After the change, on both Python 3.9.25 and 3.13, every module in `cudnn_repro/` imports without error, and:

```
$ pip install pytest looseversion && python -m pytest -q tests
43 passed, 30 skipped
```

`pre-commit run --files tools/cudnn_repro/cudnn_repro/log_parser.py tools/cudnn_repro/pyproject.toml`: black, black-jupyter and SPDX license header passed (clang-format: no files to check).

files.patch:
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@
 import re
 import sys
 from pathlib import Path
-from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Tuple
+from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Tuple
 
 
 def read_lines(source: str) -> List[str]:
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@ def read_lines(source: str) -> List[str]:
 TENSOR_DUMP_PATTERN = re.compile(r"Tensor Dump uid:\s*(-?\d+).*?Data:\s*(\[.*\])")
 
 
-def _parse_context_entry(line: str) -> Tuple[str, dict] | None:
+def _parse_context_entry(line: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, dict]]:
     stripped = line.strip()
     if '"context"' not in stripped:
         return None
@@ -36,7 +36,7 @@ def _parse_context_entry(line: str) -> Tuple[str, dict] | None:
     return stripped, payload
 
 
-def _parse_tensor_dump(line: str) -> Tuple[int, List[int]] | None:
+def _parse_tensor_dump(line: str) -> Optional[Tuple[int, List[int]]]:
     match = TENSOR_DUMP_PATTERN.search(line)
     if match is None:
         return None

@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@ build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"
 name = "cudnn-repro"
 version = "0.1.0"
 description = "Generate pytest repro commands from cuDNN Frontend logs"
-requires-python = ">=3.8"
+requires-python = ">=3.9"
 dependencies = []
 
 [project.optional-dependencies]
